themes.theme: Time and focus back for work

quotes.text: For the first time in months I made it through a full week of meetings without leaving early.
Having someone with my dad on Tuesdays means I can actually focus at work that day.
Booking the first visit took three phone calls, I almost gave up.
The scheduling portal was confusing, I wasn't sure if my booking went through.

themes.theme: Easier and less guilty to ask for help

quotes.text: I didn't have to explain myself to anyone, I just signed up. That made it easier to ask.
Knowing it was anonymous made it easier to sign up. I didn't want HR to know my situation.
The carer was great with my dad, he actually looks forward to it now.
I trust the carers now, at first I was nervous leaving my mom with a stranger.

themes.theme: Worry about when the funding ends

quotes.text: What happens in March when the funding stops? I don't want to get used to this and lose it.
I'd pay part of it myself if the company didn't, it's been that useful. But I worry it ends.
